testcase.name: remove takes an unreferenced slot away and leaves exactly the document it was before()
a duplicate logical id is refused, and so is an add without an id or a type()
a slot can be used by a query, a mapping and a view model, and the whole chain is valid()
add declares a logical slot, the document stays valid and round-trips through the codec()
removing a slot that something still references is reported by the validator with the path - no cascade, no silent fix()
no sourceRef, no credential and no connection detail is accepted on add or update()
the vocabulary now has the three slot operations - and still no operation can touch a credential or a secret()
update changes the declaration, never the physical source()
update and remove of a slot that does not exist are refused()
